programs.description: Rani, a working woman, fires her maid, Asha, who constantly takes leaves. However, when she tries to find a new maid, she realises how difficult the task is.
A young lawyer on the lookout for a fresh face for his music video meets a career-oriented banker. Soon, they fall in love and discover that they have completely opposing views about marriage.
Kunda gets her heart broken when her lover Shashikant leaves her. However, she finds solace with Ramakant and her son Sandip.
When Aaba Saheb's son Vikram informs him of his college sweetheart Kranti, the older man arranges for Kranti to stay with them for a few days. However, Vikram hatches a plan of his own.
Gauri meets Gautam and decides to get married. However, as time progresses, she learns more about her future in-laws and starts having second thoughts.
A boy from Pune and a girl from Mumbai end up spending time with each other after she asks him for directions to meet a prospective groom.
A villager embarks on a pilgrimage with his family. Things take an awry turn when a group of thugs decide to rob the family's valuables and join them in the pilgrimage.
A mill owner decides to shut down his mill and redevelop it into a shopping complex. Following this, the mill workers are left jobless, and they try to raise their voices but are tragically silenced.
A nostalgic romance unfolds when former lovers reconnect in their later years, facing new challenges and rediscovering the sweet complexities of love despite their age.
